transcript.text: Hello, this is a call from Mumbai Bank. May I speak with Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh speaking. How can I help you?

Thank you for confirming. I’m calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your credit card account. Our records show that a minimum payment of Rs 4,820 was due on 2026-10-15, and it has not yet been received. Could you please let me know if you have already made this payment, or when you plan to pay the minimum due amount?
I’m sorry, I completely forgot about the payment this month. I definitely plan to pay the full minimum amount. I can make the payment by the 4th of next month, if that’s okay.

Thank you for your response. Just to confirm, you intend to pay the minimum due amount of Rs 4,820 by November 4th, correct?

Once you confirm, I will note down your commitment. If you have any other questions, please let me know.
Yes, that's correct. I will pay the minimum amount of Rs 4,820 by November 4th. Thank you.
